Question 1
?

The equation x2+8x−33=0 can be written in the form (x+p)2=q. Find p+q, and solve the equation.

a
p+q=49,x=−11 and x=3
b
p+q=49,x=−3 and x=11
c
p+q=53,x=−11 and x=3
d
p+q=51,x=−2 and x=3
e
p+q=53,x=−9 and x=3
